thesis: The page is a sample board: every section is a physical-looking sample chip pinned to a clay field, and the signature is the cut-edge cross-section that peels apart as you scroll to reveal what the mil number actually buys.

signature.name: Sample Chip Cross-Section
signature.summary: A rectangular chip with a torn/cut left edge, a spec strip along the bottom (wear layer · thickness · core · water rating), and a tiny cross-section diagram that draws itself via --sw-p on scroll.

motion.intro: Four hero sample chips rise from a stacked pile with staggered unclip, 60ms stagger, 500ms each, ease-out.
stories: cross-section peel (pinned, layers separate vertically with labels drawing in)
